title: Junior Full-Stack Developer
description: We are seeking an ambitious Junior Full-Stack Developer to work alongside senior engineers building web applications for enterprise clients using Node.js, Express, EJS, and modern frontend technologies.
responsibilities: Develop responsive user interfaces and modular EJS/HTML templates
Build RESTful APIs and integrate server-side logic in Express.js
Collaborate on database schema design, queries, and migrations
Participate in daily standups, code reviews, and Git version control workflows
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience
Proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, and Node.js fundamentals
Familiarity with SQL databases and REST API principles
Strong problem-solving skills and eager desire to learn enterprise practices

title: Cybersecurity Research Intern
description: Join our security research team for an intensive 3-month hands-on internship focusing on web application security audits, vulnerability assessment labs, and threat modeling.
responsibilities: Perform vulnerability scans and OWASP Top 10 security audits on test environments
Assist in writing detailed security assessment reports and mitigation strategies
Analyze network traffic logs and practice incident response procedures
Participate in weekly security research workshops and CTF challenge labs
requirements: Enrolled in or recent graduate of CS, Cybersecurity, or IT degree program
Foundational knowledge of TCP/IP networking, Linux commands, and web protocols
Familiarity with security tools such as Wireshark, Burp Suite, or Nmap
High ethical standards and passion for defensive security

title: Node.js Backend Developer Intern
description: An immersive backend engineering internship designed to give computer science students hands-on experience building asynchronous microservices and API gateways.
responsibilities: Write clean, modular Node.js controller logic and middleware components
Optimize relational and NoSQL database queries for high throughput
Write automated unit tests using Jest and API integration tests
Document API endpoints utilizing OpenAPI / Swagger specifications
requirements: Basic proficiency in JavaScript/Node.js and core data structures
Understanding of HTTP status codes, JSON payload structure, and CRUD operations
Familiarity with Git branching strategies and pull request workflows
Self-motivated learner capable of working effectively in remote settings

title: Digital Marketing & Business Development Intern
description: A practical business operations internship designed for marketing and management students looking to gain real experience in tech sales, CRM management, and B2B client acquisition.
responsibilities: Assist in running targeted B2B digital marketing and outreach campaigns
Manage lead pipelines and update records in enterprise CRM software
Draft technical proposal documentation and software service decks
Analyze campaign metrics and present weekly growth insights
requirements: Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, CS, or related field
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
Familiarity with digital marketing tools, analytics, and CRM concepts
Proactive attitude and strong organizational skills

title: QA & Software Testing Intern
description: Learn modern software quality assurance practices, manual test execution, regression testing, and automated test script writing in a fast-paced software house environment.
responsibilities: Write detailed test plans, test cases, and bug replication reports
Perform cross-browser and mobile responsive UI validation checks
Collaborate with developers to verify issue resolutions and bug fixes
Learn automated E2E testing tools such as Cypress or Playwright
requirements: CS/IT background with acute attention to detail
Understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) models
Ability to articulate technical bug reproduction steps clearly
Interest in automated testing frameworks and quality engineering

title: Senior Software Engineer
description: We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to lead client project deliveries, architect scalable cloud backends, and mentor our cohort of software development interns.
responsibilities: Architect and implement scalable Node.js microservices and web apps
Perform code reviews and mentor junior developers and interns
Lead technical client discovery sessions and system architecture design
Enforce CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and security standards
requirements: 4+ years of professional software engineering experience with Node.js/JavaScript
Proven track record delivering enterprise-grade web applications
Deep understanding of database architecture, caching, and security
Strong leadership ability and passion for mentoring technical talent
